change: Synchronized the Site and preview copies of the seven generated showcase manifests with canonical composer output. Their app navigation resource references now use collapsible-sidebar rather than stale minimal-top-nav references.
notes: The first unit run was invoked before the required catalogue build and detected the stale checked-in generated manifests; after running pnpm build:catalog, the same regression passed and the full unit suite passed.
v72 Sites packaging already runs pnpm build:catalog before the static build, so this synchronizes checked-in outputs and introduces no new runtime code.
Volatile generatedAt and workbench sample timestamps were excluded from the change.
